title: Maternity & Delivery Package Enrollment Deposit — Good Faith & Price Estimates Payment Desk
content:
A patient enrolled in the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery pays an enrollment deposit on request against the package's Good Faith & Price Estimates estimate. The amount paid is the package's enrollment deposit as figured on the day of payment; once paid it is held on the package among its deposits. Paying it is the patient's own act with their own card or bank account.

## Payment tool

**Capability.** The patient pays, in person and with their own card or bank account, the enrollment deposit on their Riverbend self-pay maternity and delivery package. One call records one enrollment-deposit payment against that package: a new deposit collection of the stated amount is added to the package's deposit activity under a newly issued payment confirmation number, and the deposits held on the package rise by the same amount. The patient sees the confirmation number and the new deposits-held figure at once.

**How it is invoked.** `pay_maternity_enrollment_deposit_610ee08c` is the patient's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `estimate_id` | Id class — the reference number of the patient's maternity and delivery package estimate, as listed by the estimate lookup for this patient. |
| `amount` | Fixed-format class — the enrollment deposit the patient pays, in USD, 2 decimal places, positive magnitude (USD, 2 decimal places, positive magnitude); the value is rounded half-up to the cent when recorded, and an empty value is not accepted. |

**Return.** A text receipt `Payment accepted: deposit_txn_id=..., payment_reference=..., deposit_stage=..., amount=..., deposit_held_usd=...`, where `deposit_txn_id` is the reference number of the new deposit collection, `payment_reference` is the payment confirmation number issued for this payment (PMT- followed by 7 digits), `deposit_stage` is `INITIAL_DEPOSIT`, `amount` is the amount recorded in USD with 2 decimal places, and `deposit_held_usd` is the deposits now held on the package in USD with 2 decimal places. The receipt line beginning "Payment accepted" is the sign that the payment was recorded.

**Note on records.** The enrollment deposit is recorded in the package's deposit activity as an initial deposit collection.
